evidence.observation: O2 turns around at growth onset (13.5 ppm) after falling to ~4-8 ppm during ramp
Monotonic rise 13.5→23.9→30.9→38.3→47.4→54.5 ppm over the growth stage, consistent with progressive air ingress
Temperature holds 750 °C with Pheat ~44%, Ar steady ~100 sccm, so heater and MFC look healthy
Pressure gauge not installed; atmosphere integrity cannot be cross-checked

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure trace (or a static pressure-rise/He leak check) to confirm a seal leak and rule out exhaust restriction; also post-run characterization of the sample.
